investigations.summary: RTA PMM-T2173/T2174: the case-insensitive 'rta' filter matched a MongoDB hello command's base64 signature (z6YIJqRtajW...). Reproduced on Linode; fixed with unique labels and an 'rta-overview-' filter.

PMM-T1090: the test detoured through Inventory, where left-nav links drop the dashboard time zone (timezone=browser). Main failed 5/6 on Linode, fix passed 9/9. Open question: should the time zone survive a non-dashboard page?

nightly / ha: Helm install fails (vmauth.yaml b64dec) because the orchestrator passes HELM_CHART_BRANCH=main, and pmm3-ha-eks only works with PMM-HA-GA since jenkins-pipelines#4479. Jenkins config, not PMM; the fix is one line at pmm3-nightly-orchestrator.groovy:208.
ha: leaderStatus.test.ts still reads the HA left-menu leader item that percona/pmm#5691 removed. Already fixed in an open PR.
compat 3.9.0 PMM-T2048: I.scrollTo waited 20s on a panel visible 40ms earlier. The trace shows a 23.3s renderer paint stall over the whole wait. Timing-shaped; recurs (also 2026-09-25); not fixed.

PMM-T1090 (supersedes the earlier 'test fix' entry): the time zone is lost when navigating through Inventory, which is the known product bug PMM-15557. The test is kept and skipped until it is fixed in #1516.

Reproduced locally (exit 1 on main; exit 0 with DONT_FAIL_ON_EMPTY_RUN). The fix sets that variable, matching Playwright's --pass-with-no-tests.

nightly / ha: pmm3-ha-eks #343 hit the vmauth.yaml b64dec error again (HELM_CHART_BRANCH=main). #4493 fixed this on master, but pmm3-nightly-orchestrator reads its Jenkinsfile from branch claude/meeting-action-items-qw3ogn (PR #4489), which is 6 commits behind master and still has 'main'. Merge master into #4489's branch, or point the job at master.

ha: PMM-T2109 failed 3/3 because PUT /v1/server/settings returned 400 'Data retention ... is set via PMM_DATA_RETENTION'. The PMM-HA-GA chart has pinned retention since percona-helm-charts#933 (PMM-14787, merged 09-28), which is intended, so the test now changes only the public address. HA verification run is pending.
ha: PMM-T2233/PMM-T2144 leaderStatus timed out again on the left-menu leader that PMM-13860 removed (pmm3-ha-tests #99). Open PR #1512 already covers it.

compat / client 3.8.1 and 3.7.1: PMM-T2048 I.scrollTo timed out on 'Max Inserted Tuples' and 'Conflicts', the same renderer-stall failure as the previous nights. Open PR #1521 (opened 03:11 today) makes the anchor scroll tolerant.

The 184 MB 3.8.1 client tarball took 18.5 min at 163 KB/s, so 18 jobs were cancelled at their 40 min budget, and PMM-T2227 (tarball upgrade) hit its 120 s test timeout in 3.8.1 Generic. Diagnosed from logs only; no fix yet.

No loaded repro attempted.

investigations.summary: All three arm64 package builds died only in their Ubuntu 24.04 branch, within 2 s of each other, on one truncated read of Launchpad's 2.65 MB WADL by the unretried 'apt-add-repository --yes --update ppa:ansible/ansible' (IncompleteRead at 83-86 kB); the 22.04 and 26.04 branches ran the same command fine seconds earlier and later, and api.launchpad.net serves the full document in 1.1 s now, so it was not reproducible - jenkins-pipelines#4511 wraps the call in a bounded retry in all four PMM package-testing pipelines.

azure.archive.ubuntu.com (the GitHub runners' own Ubuntu mirror, 20.106.104.242) returned hard 502 Proxy Errors between 00:46 and 01:25, past apt's existing Acquire::Retries 3, failing the 3.8.0 MySQL 8.4 and PXC 5.7 setups and the PS/PXC/HAProxy e2e pxc setup; the degraded repo.percona.com throughput alongside it (90.7 MB in 9m22s at 162 kB/s, a 15-minute client setup) cancelled 10 CLI compat jobs at their 40-minute budget and blew PMM-T2227's 120 s timeout on 3.9.1 Generic, where 3 sibling shards ran the same test in 24-29 s. Both origins serve the same files normally now - 5th night of this class, diagnosed from logs only, no fix.

nightly / ha (INSTALLATION_TYPE=ha), 2nd night since HA got past the Helm install: 11 actionable failures over 3 shards, most of them shaped by the HA server having no self-monitored PMM Server - PMM-T878 fails on 'Service with name pmm-server is not present', PMM-T1226 and the PostgreSQL dashboards BeforeSuite destructure an undefined service lookup, and PMM-T2298/T300/T2039/T1988/T506 report empty Node Summary, PMM Health, VictoriaMetrics and Prometheus Exporters panels; QAN adds PMM-T1061 and PMM-T1142. The 7 sibling runs of the same batch (docker, ami, helm, 4 compat clients) all passed, so this is HA-specific; splitting docker-only test assumptions from a real HA gap still needs an LKE repro, which was not attempted.

compat / client 3.8.0: GitHub cancelled every test step of run 36796817384 at 01:58 and then never finalised the run - it is still 'in_progress' hours later with updated_at frozen at 01:42:40Z although all 5 jobs' steps completed by 02:03:46 - so the Jenkins lane polled it until its 4-hour stage budget expired. Nothing in the repo cancels that run (nightly-e2e-tests-matrix.yml has no concurrency group and no self-cancel), the one test that did run passed, and the 7 sibling runs of the same batch on the same SHA all completed, so this is a GitHub Actions platform fault with nothing to reproduce or fix.

investigations.summary: mocha 12 (#1538) broke mocha-junit-reporter 2.2.1 ('Class constructor Base cannot be invoked without new'), so every CodeceptJS run with --reporter mocha-multi crashed before its first test; pinned mocha back to 11.

dl.fedoraproject.org backend 38.145.32.22 returns 404 for all of /pub/epel; the PSMDB Docker image (Dockerfile EPEL install) failed whenever it hit that backend, breaking every psmdb setup. Fixed by #1542, which drops EPEL from the image.

Same EPEL 404 (dl.fedoraproject.org backend 38.145.32.22) failed all 31 OL8/OL9/AlmaLinux 10 package-test branches at the EPEL key/RPM fetch; added bounded retries in install_epel.yml and the gflags tasks. The AlmaLinux 10 pipeline step in jenkins-pipelines needs the same.

downloads.percona.com/repo.percona.com served GitHub runners at 180-370 KB/s during the run, so 9 CLI compat jobs hit the 40-minute timeout and PMM-T2227 overran its 120 s budget in the 3 Generic jobs; transient, and the downloads are fast now.
ami 3.9.0 (1243) failed its psmdb setup on a one-off Docker Hub 'connection reset by peer' pulling alpine:latest for the kerberos image; the AMI job does not retry setup.

All 18 Upgrade AMD lanes: #1432 deleted support_scripts/check_client_upgrade.py, which pmm3-upgrade-test-runner still runs in its Check Client before/after Upgrade stages (python3 exits 2 on the missing file; reproduced). Restored unchanged; Jenkins consoles were unreadable (403), so attribution is from the pipeline source.

nightly / ha: same failure set as nightly 54 (PMM-T2298/T300/T2039/T418/T1988/T506/T878, empty Node Summary, PMM Health and VictoriaMetrics panels), all in one shard; HA-specific, an HA cluster repro was not attempted. gssapi and ami 3.8.0 are Jenkins-only and their consoles returned 403, so they were not diagnosed.

CLI compat one-offs, each green on the other 5 client versions: PMM-T2227 timed out after a 9.7 min run on 3.8.0 Generic (30-60 s elsewhere), and ps-8.0 never appeared in pmm-admin list on 3.7.1 client-docker, the setup race open PR #1548 hardens. Nightly runs cannot be re-run.

investigations.summary: repo.percona.com served pmm3-client experimental binary-amd64 Packages.gz files that did not match the 20:15 UTC Release index (1166/1167 vs 1165 bytes, 'Mirror sync in progress?') between 20:37 and 20:42 UTC, so apt failed on every Debian/Ubuntu branch; the repo is consistent now and apt update on noble and bookworm passes on a fresh VM, while arm64 and RPM lanes were green: an external repo publish race, not pmm-qa or PMM.

MongoDB Sharded Cluster Summary @post-upgrade failed because verifyAllPanelsHaveData reported only its last pass, and with 5s auto-refresh panels such as Top Hottest Collections alternate between data and empty results; reproduced on a CHAOS VM under load, fixed by counting a panel as missing only when every pass shows it empty.

Compatibility CLI 3.8.1 Generic PMM-T2227 (tarball upgrade) ran 14.7m against a 120s test timeout because the two ~180 MB client tarball downloads were slow; already covered by the open PR that raises its timeout to 20 min.

Between about 20:37 and 20:45 UTC, repo.percona.com (15.204.182.114) served pmm3-client experimental binary-amd64 Packages.gz files that did not match the 20:15 UTC Release index for bookworm, trixie, jammy, noble and resolute, so apt failed every Debian/Ubuntu stage in all 8 jobs while the RPM stages passed; #474's noble stage fetched cleanly at 20:47 and passed, and the repo is consistent now, so this was an external repo publish race.

EKS cluster was deleted with no pod events, so likely EKS infra (volume/scheduling); watch the next HA nightly.

investigations.summary: pmm-agent stops restarting an exporter after its second restart (PMM-15717); in @instances the Azure MySQL exporter crashed three times because port 42020 was briefly held by an outgoing connection (PMM-11935, the agent's port check only tests 127.0.0.1), so it stayed down and azure_memory_percent_average never appeared for PMM-T743.

npm ci in the Install playwright step died after 17s with a one-off ECONNRESET from registry.npmjs.org before PMM was set up; 37 in-window npm ci runs on the same lockfile succeeded, all 306 lockfile tarballs are served, and a full replay on a CHAOS VM passed npm ci 3/3 and all 4 @valkey tests with client 3.8.1.

The GitHub-hosted runner running the databases-only shard extra-pxc-pdpgsql-haproxy lost communication around 01:42, so pdpgsql_pmm_17_1_3311 stopped sending metrics and PMM-T2048 found the instant-query "Autovacuum" table empty; it passes with client 3.8.0 when the service is healthy and fails the same way when the container is paused.

pmm3-client_integration_custom_path starts pmm-agent in the background and runs pmm-admin status ~0.19 s later without waiting, so on ubuntu2404-arm64 the agent had not yet opened 127.0.0.1:7777 in either attempt (connection refused) though it came up connected seconds later; reproduced on main by slowing the agent's start, fixed by waiting for the port after every background start.

investigations.summary: CLI Generic: pmm-admin --version and summary --version tests expect the server's version (3.10.0-v3-29d0075b2) but the pmm3-rc client prints 3.10.0; the server image perconalab/pmm-server:3.10.0-rc reports a v3-<sha> dev-style version. From run logs only, no VM reproduction.

CodeceptJS @ssl-mysql: PMM-T1403/T1404/T1426/T1431 (maxQueryLength empty variant) timed out because the QAN Explain tab kept showing 'Error 1064 (42000): You have an error in your SQL', the only failure of 15; 14 others passed. From run logs only, no VM reproduction.

ha backup-restore: PMM-T2371 failed on 'min(up{job=kube-apiserver})' = 0 after the in-place restore on OpenShift with perconalab/pmm-server:3.10.0-rc; the same test passed on OpenShift in pmm3-ha-tests #137 (no restore) and in backup-restore #11 (3-dev-latest). The cluster was already deleted and no OpenShift reproduction was run.

@ssl-mysql PMM-T1403 (maxQueryLength "" row): the perfschema QAN agent sometimes stores MySQL's normalised digest text (SELECT COUNT ( * ) …) as example and explain fingerprint, so EXPLAIN fails with Error 1064; not truncation, same defect failed the -1 row on 2026-10-15.

The 3.10.0 RC server build reused pmm-managed, qan-api2 and vmproxy RPMs a v3 dev build had put in the shared S3 cache (cache key omits the embedded version), so perconalab/pmm-server:3.10.0-rc reports 3.10.0-v3-29d0075b2 while the RC client reports 3.10.0; reproduced on a CHAOS VM.

ha backup-restore PMM-T2371: up{job=kube-apiserver} stayed 0 for ~6 min (15:38-15:44Z, all 3 attempts) while kubelet/cAdvisor/node-exporter were up; a re-run on the same 3.10.0-rc image (backup-restore #14) passed 25/25 and live probes on two fresh ROSA clusters showed the apiserver target up throughout. Unconfirmed lead: the ROSA apiserver /metrics is 13-15 MB with spikes to 17.9 MB on some backends, above the 16 MiB vmagent -promscrape.maxScrapeSize the chart leaves at default.

investigations.summary: GitHub-hosted runners with kernel 6.19+ cannot start mongod (log: 'MongoDB cannot start: Linux kernel versions 6.19 and newer has a known incompatibility', SERVER-121912), so pmm3-client_integration* fail on the unlucky runners while identical jobs pass elsewhere; read in ol10-arm64, ol8-amd64 and GSSAPI ol9-amd64 logs, the 3.9.1 docker upgrade (psmdb primary ECONNREFUSED 27017) is inferred; no VM repro, runner kernel cannot be mimicked and nightly cannot be re-run.

All @ssl-mysql tests passed (test step succeeded); only the 2-second 'Record launchable test results' step failed, a Launchable reporting hiccup, not a product or test defect; not reproduced, not investigated further.

pmm3-upgrade-ami-test-runner asserts the upgraded server reports PMM_SERVER_LATEST, which the orchestrator reads from pmm-submodules v3/VERSION (3.10.1), but the RC image is 3.10.0, so all 5 AMI upgrades fail at 'expected 3.10.1'; fix is in jenkins-pipelines pmm/v3/pmm3-nightly-orchestrator.groovy: pass the RC version (imageTag minus -rc) as PMM_SERVER_LATEST when isRc; no PR opened yet.

Only PMM-T2371 failed (kube-apiserver up=0 for 2 min after 3 retries) on OpenShift 4.21 with the 3.10.0-rc server; build 139 passed it with 3-dev-latest on the same cluster type and chart branch, the chart tip only bumped version tags in between, so a 3.10.0-rc vs dev difference is suspected but unproven; no repro, OpenShift cluster is gone and CHAOS has k3s only.

investigations.summary: Infra, not PMM or tests: both HA lanes died provisioning OpenShift because pmm3-ha-rosa #350/#351 (and #352 at 06:49) get CLUSTERS-MGMT-400 'billing account 119175775298 not linked to organization 1IQQauGmwrUH143LVRXQKXXnVHC at the aws marketplace'; #349 at 01:15 UTC was the last success, so the ROSA/AWS Marketplace billing link broke overnight and needs DevOps/account-owner action before any HA lane can run.

Same cause as #83/#84: PSMDB 8.0.32 refuses to start on the GitHub runner image ubuntu-24.04 20261015.610 (kernel 6.19+; mongod logs 'MongoDB cannot start: Linux kernel versions 6.19 and newer has a known incompatibility', SERVER-121912). All 37 failed package/GSSAPI jobs and both UI upgrade setups (3.6.0, 3.7.1) ran on 20261015.610; 0 of 105 jobs on 20261012.601 failed. Runner-environment issue, no pmm-qa or PMM defect; needs a PSMDB build that supports kernel 6.19 or pinning these jobs off the new image.

All 5 AMI upgrades fail 'PMM Server reports 3.10.0 / expected 3.10.1': pmm3-nightly-orchestrator passes pmm-submodules v3/VERSION (now 3.10.1) as PMM_SERVER_LATEST even for the 3.10.0-rc image; fix passes the RC tag's version instead.

PMM_PXC_TEST 'Verify dashboard after PXC Instances are added' found 5 empty panels (Ready to Accept Queries, Local State, Desync Mode, Cluster Status) against 3 tolerated on PXC Galera Node Summary for the client node; two CI-identical re-dispatches of PMM_PROXYSQL.yaml on main (3.10.0-rc server, pmm3-rc client, PXC 8.0) passed 4/4 each (runs 39392110719, 39392120917), and it passed on nights #80-#84, so this is an intermittent wsrep panel gap, not a PMM or test defect confirmed.

GitHub ubuntu-24.04 runner images 20261018.* moved to kernel 7.0, where PSMDB 8.0.32 refuses to start (SERVER-121912); the fix makes rseq fail with ENOSYS for mongod so tcmalloc per-CPU caches stay off (Integrations: only the GSSAPI ol8 tarball job)
On RC nights the orchestrator passes the dev version 3.10.1 from pmm-submodules v3/VERSION as PMM_SERVER_LATEST, so the RC server's correct 3.10.0 fails the post-upgrade version check
pmm3-ha-rosa can't create any ROSA cluster since ~04:27Z because AWS billing account 119175775298 is no longer linked to the Red Hat organization; an account admin has to relink it
PMM_PXC_TEST saw 5 empty Galera status panels for pxc_node__2 on an unaffected kernel-6.8 runner; passed in the previous and 2026-10-17 nightlies and in every repro run

investigations.summary: PMM-T2401 (new in #1651) failed in all 10 nightly E2E runs: it expects an Oplog GB/Hour panel for every rsNNN_N service, but the shared nightly server also carries the pss replica set (rs101-rs103, cluster replicaset) from the mysql-psmdb-pgsql shard, which the cluster=sharded dashboard never draws. Reproduced on a CHAOS VM; the fix filters to cluster=sharded and opens the dashboard at refresh=30s, as a 5s refresh also timed out the loading-bar wait in 3 of 10 runs.

All three upgrades from 3.7.1 died in setup with 'Could not fetch the PMM Client package': each codename's pmm3-client apt index keeps the last 5 releases, so 3.10.0 pushed 3.7.1 out of noble/jammy, while the upgrade matrix still starts from it (the workflow's pool check is fooled by leftover bullseye debs). Reproduced on a CHAOS VM; the fix makes pmm-framework install a pinned release from its downloads.percona.com tarball when apt no longer has it.

pmm3-ha-tests #150 (via pmm3-ha-rosa #366) and pmm3-ha-backup-restore-tests #23 cloned percona-helm-charts branch PMM-HA-GA, which no longer exists: the jobs still held their old HELM_CHART_BRANCH default when the orchestrator fired them. jenkins-pipelines #4608 (merged 2026-10-22) moved the default to main, and both jobs now show main, so the next nightly picks it up; no further fix needed.

PMM_PXC_TEST hit its 40-minute timeout before the tests ran because 'playwright install --with-deps' pulled 89.4 MB from azure.archive.ubuntu.com at 48 kB/s (30m51s); the job normally takes 9-11 minutes, and its re-run on the same commit passed in 11 minutes.

investigations.summary: PMM-T1698 asserts data in the MongoDB ReplSet Summary 'Replication Lag' panel, whose query keeps only lag > 0, so it is empty whenever no secondary lags: the helm run's trace shows every refresh empty for rs102/rs103 at 0 lag (also gssapi). Fix allows the panel to be empty and waits for the lag series itself; verified 3/3 on a CHAOS VM.

PMM-T2051 (compat 3.8.0, 3.8.1): the PostgreSQL Replication Overview 'Replicas' table is built from flush_lag_seconds, which PostgreSQL nulls once standbys catch up, so after an hour without writes it empties while 'Number of Replicas' still shows 2. Reproduced on a CHAOS VM (passed 16:52, failed 2/2 at 17:25 with no writes in between); not client-version specific.

Docker Hub returned 500 on pgsty/minio blobs and 'unauthorized' on redis:latest between 13:29:54 and 13:30:23Z, failing setup in Upgrade 3.7.0 Docker, Upgrade 3.8.1 UI and the AMI 3.8.1 upgrade lane; the re-run of the GitHub jobs passed (the Jenkins AMI lane could not be re-run from here: no jenkins-mcp-writers access).

CLI 3.9.0 PXC 8.0, MongoDB SSL and FB PSMDB Replica jobs hung in apt-get update / playwright install --with-deps on azure.archive.ubuntu.com until their job timeouts (same mirror as night #89); all three passed on re-run.

compat 3.9.0: pmm3-aws-staging-start #27360's PMM Server missed its 100s readiness check on a slow EC2 host (image pull 2m10s vs 36-55s, Grafana migrations 12.9s vs 2.7s on its siblings); sibling #27362 on the same image and minute was ready in 47s. Not re-run: no Jenkins write access from this session, the link is the in-window control.

investigations.summary: PSMDB Arbiter 8.3 compat jobs (clients 3.8.0-3.10.0) died in setup: #1634 adds the arbiter by hostname, which on PSMDB 8.1+ needs the 3.11.0 agent fix (percona/pmm#6024, PMM-15650); released clients get 'buildInfo requires authentication'. Reproduced on a CHAOS VM; fix falls back to 127.0.0.1 for released clients before 3.11.0.

nightly/docker: pmm3-aws-staging-start #27375's PMM Server missed its 100s readiness wait on a slow EC2 host (agent boot 4m26s vs 2m20s, image pull 2m33s vs ~50s, Grafana first-boot dashboard sync ~25s); sibling #27376, same image, instance type and minute, was ready in <47s. Same cause as night #90's compat 3.9.0. Re-run #1266 passed.

@ssl-mysql PMM-T1403 (default Max Query Length row, x64+ARM): the qan-mysql-perfschema agent missed the query in events_statements_history and fell back to DIGEST_TEXT as the example (perfschema.go:408-412); QAN's Explain then ran 'SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM ...', which MySQL 8.4 rejects with Error 1064 (confirmed on a CHAOS VM). Existing ticket PMM-12069. The history miss itself didn't reproduce (3 idle + 6 loaded runs green; ARM re-run green).

investigations.summary: All 5 AMI upgrade lanes (pmm3-upgrade-ami-test-runner #1437-#1441) died again in 'Setup Dependencies and PMM Client' on 'sudo npx playwright install-deps chromium' (apt-get: command not found, exit 127) before any test ran. Same cause as night 94; the fix, jenkins-pipelines#4627, is still open and unmerged.

pmm3-ha-tests #157: PMM-T2108 got pg_exporter_scrapes_total from 2 of 3 PostgreSQL sources on a fresh ROSA install. One internal pg-db instance is never monitored; this is PMM-15794 recurring (New; recurrence noted on the ticket).

pmm3-ha-backup-restore-tests #31: 'Install PMM HA with backups' failed on the ROSA API lookup ('no such host'), 6.6 min after the cluster turned ready. Third time in seven runs (#26, #29). pmm3-ha-rosa already waits out this 15-min cached NXDOMAIN with withClusterApiRetry; this job's install ran without it. Fix wraps the install the same way.

pmm3-ui-tests #11915: PMM-T743 found no azure_memory_percent_average in 2x90s, while the same Azure service's mysql_global_status_max_used_connections row passed. That metric comes from Azure Monitor through azure_exporter. Re-run #11917 on the same image and branch passed (47 CodeceptJS + 14 Playwright). The Azure-side delay is inferred, not proven; it is the first such failure in the last 8 @instances runs.

compat client 3.8.1 (GH run 40980845498) died in setup on shard ps-replication-psmdb-sharded: the runner was slow (InnoDB init took 70s and PS never accepted connections), rs102 registration got HTTP 500 ten times, and the retry got 'Invalid username or password' (likely Grafana's login lockout after those attempts). No server logs survived to confirm the 500s. Re-run #1298 passed all 5 shards.

investigations.summary: @fb-instances ran no tests: haproxy_pmm publishes host port 42100, inside the ephemeral range, and an outbound socket already holding it as a source port made docker run fail with 'address already in use' (the ip_local_reserved_ports sysctl cannot free a port already taken); reproduced on a CHAOS VM, fix publishes host port 8404 instead.

PMM-T554 after the AMI 3.9.0 container upgrade read the inventory once ~2 s after readyz while remote pmm-agents were still in their reconnect backoff (up to ~20 s); reproduced on a CHAOS VM, fix polls the same assertion for up to 2 min, and Jenkins re-runs #1448-#1450 on the fix branch passed.

ami 3.8.1 and 3.7.1 aborted: pmm3-ami-staging-start #3827 read the new VM public IP 2 s after launch (empty), then its unbounded SSH wait retried admin@ for 71 min until the 90-min timeout, with #3828 queued behind it; fix reads the IP after instance-running with a 2-min bound and caps the SSH wait at 10 min.

PMM-T2371 on ROSA: the pmm-ha chart's vmagent keeps the 16 MiB default promscrape.maxScrapeSize while ROSA HCP's apiserver /metrics is 13-16.75 MB and growing, so on some nights the scrape is rejected and kube-apiserver goes up=0; reproduced on k3s (fails over the limit, passes with 64MiB), re-run #159 passed 26 KB under the limit.

PMM-T2340 | remote-mongodb: an earlier test's failure (RDS 409 on a node the CodeceptJS stage left behind) restarts the Playwright worker, whose afterAll wipes the remote nodes ~60 s after mongodb_remote_new is added, before the profiler's first per-minute QAN bucket; reproduced on a CHAOS VM, fix pre-deletes the leftover RDS node and re-adds the remote services before the QAN checks (Jenkins #11958/#11959 green on the branch).

investigations.summary: compat client 3.9.1: pmm-framework 'Configure Patroni' failed both attempts with "rm: cannot remove .../pg_wal: Directory not empty", which blocked all 5 test shards. systemctl stop postgresql stops only the Debian wrapper unit, which postgresql@17-main is ordered Before=, so it returns while the cluster is still deactivating (6 postgres processes measured) and the shutdown checkpoint writes into the dir rm is emptying. Reproduced on a CHAOS VM under load (1/12 vs 0/12 with the fix). The fix stops postgresql@<ver>-main; the exact CI setup passed 3/3 on the fix branch.

pmm3-ha-tests #160 on ROSA: PMM-T2108 got pg_exporter_scrapes_total from 2 of 3 PostgreSQL sources on all 3 attempts (23/24 passed). This is the known PMM-15794 (New; one internal pg-db instance is never monitored), the same signature as nights 93 and 95. No new ticket and no re-run; not re-reproduced this session.

@ssl-mysql (amd64): PMM-T1403/T1404/T1426/T1431 found QAN Explain for the remote SSL MySQL service showing 'Error 1064 (42000): You have an error in your SQL syntax' for 60 s. This matches the open PMM-12069 (QAN runs EXPLAIN on the fingerprint instead of the example), so no new ticket. The failure is intermittent: also red on night 92. The rerun of the same job passed 15/15 (job 125071496892). Not reproduced on a VM this session.

@bm-mongo (ARM64 FB lane): a PHYSICAL filesystem restore of mongo-backup-inventory-1 never reached RESTORE_STATUS_SUCCESS, and every later backup on that replica set then stayed unfinished (10 failed, 22 passed). First red in 10 nights; the amd64 and GSSAPI @bm-mongo lanes passed the same night, and the rerun passed 32/6-skipped (job 125071500040). Root cause not established: the artifact's pmm-managed.log is rotated (it starts at 02:03, after the 01:39 restore) and has no logs from the mongo nodes.

investigations.summary: pmm3-ui-tests #11995: PMM-T564 expected severity 'Notice' and got 'Info'. percona/pmm#6230 (PMM-15239) merged 2026-11-02 22:02 UTC and collapses the eight severity levels into four bands, so the test's raw-level assertion is now stale. Already fixed by pmm-qa#1674, which was a draft waiting on that merge and can be marked ready now. Deduped, not re-reproduced.

pmm3-ha-tests #161 on ROSA: PMM-T2108 got pg_exporter_scrapes_total from 2 of 3 PostgreSQL sources on all 3 attempts (23/24 passed). This is the known PMM-15794 (New), the same signature as nights 91/93/95/97, and pmm-qa#1710 proposes skipping it. Deduped, not re-reproduced.

pmm3-ha-backup-restore-tests #34, HA tests on the restored cluster: PMM-T2371 read min(up{job="kube-apiserver"})=0 on all 3 attempts (24/25 passed). This is the known PMM-15833 (New), where vmagent's 16 MiB default maxScrapeSize drops the ROSA apiserver /metrics; first seen on nights 94/96. Deduped, not re-reproduced.

investigations.summary: pmm-qa#1668 (PMM-15595, merged Nov 3) expects the MongoDB ClusterSync Details dashboard and menu item, which ship only in the still-open percona/pmm#6020. PMM-T1086 failed in every nightly and compat lane (docker, arm64, ami, helm, ha, client 3.7.1-3.9.1) and PMM-T2202 in both New Navigation jobs. Reproduced on a CHAOS VM with 3-dev-latest; fixed in pmm-qa#1722. The PCSM UI suite (PMM-T2474) stays red until pmm#6020 merges.

ami 3.7.1: Prepare's git clone of pmm-qa hit 'Failed to connect to github.com port 443: Connection timed out' one second after a successful fetch on the same agent. The re-run #1466 with identical parameters passed.

PMM-T2435 (GSSAPI OL8+OL9 CLI lanes, which run plain SCRAM): after a ChangeAgent races the exporter's RUNNING status report, PMM Server keeps showing mongodb_exporter as Starting while pmm-agent runs it. Reproduced on a CHAOS VM under load (1/3). Known PMM-15835; evidence added there.

PMM-T2456 (OL9 CLI lane, plus FB pmm-submodules#4676): getQanExample looks the example up by query ID only, so the framework's rs101 profiler on the same mongod can return its untruncated example. Both rows confirmed in ClickHouse on a CHAOS VM; fixed in pmm-qa#1723.

@ssl-mysql (ARM64): PMM-T1403/T1404/T1426/T1431 saw QAN Explain show 'Error 1064 (42000)' for the remote SSL MySQL service for 60 s. This is the open PMM-12069 (Explain runs on the fingerprint), the same as nights 92 and 97. Deduped, not re-reproduced.

ha backup-restore #35: PMM-T2107 checked pmm-ha-1 while it was still Terminating after PMM-T2136's leader failover. getPods counts a terminating pod as Ready, and the agent check had no retry. It surfaced once pmm-qa#1710 skipped PMM-T2108, which used to fill that gap. Fixed in pmm-qa#1721; the same job on the fix branch, #36, passed 23/0/2.

All 10 nightly lanes (docker, docker arm64, ami, ha, helm, compat 3.7.1-3.9.1) failed only PMM-T1086, and both New Navigation jobs failed PMM-T2202: pmm-qa#1668 (merged 11-03) expects the MongoDB ClusterSync Details dashboard and menu item, which ship in the still-open percona/pmm#6020, so 3-dev-latest has neither. Fix (reproduced on a CHAOS VM) drops them from the generic folder/menu checks until pmm#6020 merges. The @pmm-pcsm-psmdb-integration lane (PMM-T2474) fails for the same reason and stays red until pmm#6020 lands.

ha backup-restore #35: PMM-T2107 read the standby pmm-ha-1 while it was still Terminating after PMM-T2136's leader failover; K8sHelper.getPods counts a terminating pod as Ready. #1710 skipping PMM-T2108 removed the 15 min that used to separate the two tests. Fix treats a pod with deletionTimestamp as not ready and polls the standby's agent for 2 min. Fix PR from a sibling investigator session, deduped and not re-reproduced here; its Jenkins verification #36 was still running at publish time.

ami 3.7.1 (pmm3-upgrade-ami-test-runner #1461) died in Prepare on 'git clone https://github.com/percona/pmm-qa.git: Failed to connect to github.com port 443: Connection timed out' before any test ran; the other four AMI lanes passed. Re-run #1467 with identical parameters passed every stage.

@ssl-mysql (amd64): PMM-T1403/T1404/T1426/T1431 saw QAN Explain show 'Error 1064 (42000): You have an error in your SQL syntax' for the remote SSL MySQL service (14 passed, 1 failed). Same signature as nights 92 and 97: the open PMM-12069 (QAN runs EXPLAIN on the fingerprint). Deduped, not re-reproduced.

Update to the ClusterSync finding: at the reviewer's request, pmm-qa#1722 is closed. #1668 is reverted in pmm-qa#1724, which also takes the PCSM UI suite off main. The tests return in draft pmm-qa#1725, blocked on percona/pmm#6020.

@ssl-mysql follow-up: the Explain that failed ran on the digest 'SELECT COUNT ( * ) FROM ...' (PMM-12069), which MySQL can't parse. At the reviewer's request the test now uses SELECT *, whose digest explains cleanly (checked on MySQL 8.4), in pmm-qa#1726.

investigations.summary: helm: PMM-T1061 opened the Plan tab of 'CREATE DATABASE school' instead of the pgsm_t1 query. The Playwright trace shows the 'Last 12 hours' getReport (search "") returned 1130 ms after it was sent, which was after the newer 'pgsm_t1 t1' search response, and replaced it in the table. QAN's useOverviewTable has no guard against stale responses. Reproduced 3/3 on a CHAOS VM (3-dev-latest), control clean. Filed PMM-15883.

compat client 3.8.1: PMM-T1333 found 'Top 5 Hottest Collections by Read/Write (Rate)' empty on all 3 attempts, while the (Total) panels on the same dashboard had data. Those panels use rate(...[$__rate_interval]) over the topmetrics series, which is the open PMM-15714 (the window rarely holds a sample). Deduped, not re-reproduced.

PSMDB Replica 8.x: PMM-T2435 (mongoDb-psmdb-change-agent.spec.ts) failed with 'PMM Server should report <agent> as Running'. This is the known PMM-15835 (To Do): a change agent is reverted when it races the agent's status report. Same signature as night 99. Deduped, not re-reproduced.

docker upgrade 3.6.0: 'Verify grafana logs after upgrade' found Grafana 'failed to save dashboard: context deadline exceeded' on both attempts. Both errors fell inside the client-upgrade step (dnf in 13 tarball-installed containers at once), during which the whole server stalled. That step took 661s and 733s against 287-386s on earlier nights, while 3.7.0 was normal and 3.8+ took about 60s. The re-run linked here also failed and the slowdown's cause is not identified, so this is unstable for lack of a better verdict.

investigations.summary: compat client 3.8.0, PSMDB Replica 6.x: PMM-T2438 went red in the change-agent describe's afterAll. After moving pmm-agent back to port 7777, the hook waited only for 'pmm-admin status' to exit 0, and that exits 0 while it prints 'Connected : false'. 'pmm-admin remove' then failed with 'pmm-agent is not connected to PMM Server'. 1 failure in 24 runs over nights 99-102. On a CHAOS VM (client 3.8.0, psmdb 6.0 pss), status exited 0 while disconnected on 1 of 5 restarts. The spec passed on the fix branch (23 passed). The in-place re-run also passed.

@pmm-psmdb-sharding-integration (amd64): pmm-framework setup died after 17 s with 'createbucket Error unauthorized: authentication required' while pulling the minio images, before any test ran. Both images (pgsty/minio:RELEASE.2026-08-04T00-00-00Z and pgsty/mc:RELEASE.2026-09-16T00-00-00Z) are public and still on Docker Hub, and the ARM64 shard pulled them fine the same night, so this was a transient registry-auth error. The in-place re-run set up cleanly and passed 3 tests.

upgrade 3.7.0 (UI): 'Verify grafana logs after upgrade' found 'failed to save dashboard ... Memory_Details.json error=context deadline exceeded' at 01:00:47, on all 3 attempts. It was logged during upgrade_clients.sh, which upgrades every client container at once and took 411 s here; the re-run took 341 s and passed. This is the same signature as night 100 (3.6.0, 661/733 s), so it recurs: the client-upgrade step stalls the server long enough for Grafana's dashboard provisioning to time out. No fix yet; the step's duration regression still needs root-causing.

nightly ha (pmm3-ui-tests-nightly-gha #1363): PMM-T1226 (empty process_exec_path) and PMM-T2007 (9 PostgreSQL services in inventory, 8 on the home panel) have one cause. The postgres_exporter of the internal HA instance pmm-pmm-ha-pg-db-instance1-cjcg-0 stayed AGENT_STATUS_UNKNOWN for 45 min, with no exec path, while its pmm-agent and QAN agent were connected and running. pmm-managed logged 'dial tcp 10.100.84.160:5432: connection refused' 3 times on that agent's Connect stream at 00:56:05-06, which drops its status writes. This is the open PMM-15716. Deduped from the run's artifacts, not re-reproduced; the panel undercount also suggests that exporter sent no metrics.

investigations.summary: PMM-T2036 failed in all 11 nightly lanes (docker, docker arm64, ami, helm, ha, compat 3.7.1-3.9.1, gssapi) with 'Metrics without data are: Failing Backup Agents'. percona/pmm#6109 (PMM-15484, merged 11-09 15:16) added that table to MongoDB Backup Details; it lists only failing PBM agents, and the run's page snapshot shows it in its healthy 'No failing backup agents' state. MongodbBackupDetails.noDataMetrics is empty, so the generic all-panels check flags it. The fix (noDataMetrics = ['Failing Backup Agents']) is already in draft pmm-qa#1740, which was blocked on pmm#6109 and can now be made ready. Deduped from the run artifacts, not re-reproduced.

upgrade 3.7.0 (UI + Docker): PMM-T2385 found ReplSet Summary 'State'/'Version' empty for rs102/rscfg01 (UI) and rs202 (Docker), and the UI leg's 'Verify grafana logs after upgrade' found 'failed to save dashboard' (the nights 100/102 signature). Same cause as those nights, now worse: upgrade_clients.sh dnf-installs pmm-client in 13 containers at once, only on 3.6.0/3.7.0 (tarball-installed because not in apt), and took 720/794 s vs 409/410 s last night and ~60 s on 3.7.1+. In that window the Docker leg's pmm-managed logged 320 'GET :3000/api/auth/serviceaccount: context deadline exceeded' on the /victoriametrics auth path (01:00-01:07), Grafana's PG statements were cancelled, and pings failed to every pmm-agent, so the exporters' remote writes were refused. The re-run (attempt 2) passed both legs: UI with a 395 s upgrade, Docker with 797 s, so the stall is intermittent in effect and was reproduced in duration. No fix yet: the step's slowness still needs root-causing on a CHAOS VM (per-container dnf logs are discarded on success). PMM-T2185 (RTA sort) was flaky on retry in both attempts.

ha backup-restore #40: PMM-T2377 failed in its first step, 'At least one service must be monitored', 10 s into the test. The trace shows the up query (max by service_name of timestamp(up==1)) returned only 2 internal HA services, both last sampled at 00:55:00, 168 s before the check (cutoff 120 s). The ps/psmdb services registered at 00:56:58-00:57:37 had no up sample yet. pmm-managed logged the internal PostgreSQL shutting down / refusing connections / read-only in recovery at 00:55:12, right after the PG pods rolled at 00:54-00:55, so ingestion had not resumed when the test started. The setup-to-test gap (~10 s) is the same as in the green #38/#39. The servicesRunningAndReporting check is one-shot, with no wait. The re-run #41 with identical parameters passed T2377 (13.5 m).

ui @instances #12104: PMM-T2010 'Verify Dashboard for Aurora Postgres RDS added via UI' failed only for the Aurora PostgreSQL 16 instance (the PG15 one passed): 'Execution time' empty on PostgreSQL Instances Overview over now-5m, about 40 s after the instance was added. Not reproduced: the re-run #12106 with identical parameters passed. The panel depends on query activity on the external AWS Aurora instance inside a 5-minute window, which the test does not generate; if it recurs, that is the next thing to check.

investigations.summary: PMM-T2036 failed again in all 11 nightly lanes (docker, docker arm64, ami, helm, ha, compat 3.7.1-3.9.1, gssapi), in every case only with 'Metrics without data are: Failing Backup Agents' (Nightly 2/4 shard; one PMM-T305 loading-bar flake on ha passed on retry). Same cause as night 103: the Failing Backup Agents table added by percona/pmm#6109 is empty when no PBM agent fails, and MongodbBackupDetails.noDataMetrics on main still lacks it. The one-line fix is in pmm-qa#1740, which is not merged yet; merging it clears these lanes. Deduped from the run logs, not re-reproduced.

ha backup-restore #42: PMM-T2377 failed in its first step, 'At least one service must be monitored', like #40. The one-shot capture kept only services whose timestamp(up==1) was newer than now-120s, and on this HA cluster that query returns timestamps on a 5-minute grid: #42 read 136 s past the boundary and got 4 stale internal services (#40 168 s, green #41 104 s), and even green runs never included the ps/psmdb services. Fix PR polls until every running service reports; verified in #43 on the fix branch (SUCCESS, 23 passed): its first poll matched the failing shape and the 15th, at the next boundary, had all 8 services, which the restore check then verified.

upgrade 3.6.0 UI: 'Verify grafana logs after upgrade' found 'failed to save dashboard ... context deadline exceeded' at 01:02:48, inside the 782 s client-upgrade step: the nights 100/102/103 signature. Root cause: upgrade_clients.sh runs dnf install pmm-client in all 13 tarball-installed containers at once, and each downloads and solves the full OL9 (plus EPEL/PGDG) metadata. On a 4-CPU/16 GB CHAOS VM replay that held 6.5 GB RSS in dnf, left 300 MB free, load ~400, and PMM readyz stopped answering. Fix PR caps it at 4 at a time; dispatched upgrade runs on the branch passed 3.6.0 UI (step 307 s) and 3.7.0 Docker (433 s), both with the Grafana log check green.

investigations.summary: PMM-T2036 failed again in all 11 nightly lanes (docker, docker arm64, ami, helm, ha, compat 3.7.1/3.8.0/3.8.1/3.9.0/3.9.1, gssapi). Every time it was the only hard failure, and every time with 'Metrics without data are: Failing Backup Agents' (Nightly 2/4 shard). The PMM-T1698, PMM-T2401 and PMM-T318 failures on helm, ha, ami, docker and compat 3.9.0 passed on retry. Same cause as nights 103 and 104: the Failing Backup Agents table that percona/pmm#6109 added is empty when no PBM agent fails, and MongodbBackupDetails.noDataMetrics on main still doesn't list it. The fix (noDataMetrics = ['Failing Backup Agents']) is in pmm-qa#1740, which is still open and unmerged. Merging it clears these lanes. Deduped from the run logs, not re-reproduced.
